artist.name: Sid Praja
artist.bio: Sid Praja is a DJ and producer from Jodhpur. A self-taught DJ who started after moving to England in 2014, he mixes acid, breaks, techno and hip-hop. His releases include the single 'No more Genocide' (2025) and 'Vigil' with Kaamin on Padmini Records' compilation Yaar-Dost Vol. 2 (2026).

eras.sound: Euphoric breakbeat with plucked melodies and abstract pads
